entities.name: Hexhaven Academy
entities.description: The Echoverse's dystopian, regimented battlemage academy and the Theorist's inner sanctum, a counterpart of Strixhaven with five allied-colored schools.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: The Echoverse's version of Jace, who stabilizes the Echoverse from his sanctum atop Hexhaven's tower and surveils it constantly.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: A new Multiverse layered over the existing one, guided by the Theorist.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Hexhaven, unpredictable and in wild flux in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Uldaros Theorix
entities.description: An elder sphinx who built the original fortress with reality-bending magic.

entities.name: Elder sphinxes
entities.description: Five sphinxes born from merged mana who offered protection and founded the academy.

entities.name: Fatehold
entities.description: Hexhaven's school of Future History, whose mages predict and steer futures.

entities.name: Theorix
entities.description: Hexhaven's school of Esoteric Mathematics, whose cadets tend toward insanity.

entities.name: Stingerquill
entities.description: Hexhaven's school of Painful Words, the Theorist's frontline troops.

entities.name: Konstrari
entities.description: Hexhaven's school of Constructive Arts, building constructs and puppet soldiers.

entities.name: Vigorbloom
entities.description: Hexhaven's school of Invasive Healing, using plants to heal battle mages.

entities.name: Theorist's Tower
entities.description: An impossible tower rising from the plane's largest leyline confluence, housing the campus and the Theorist's sanctum.

entities.name: Eradia
entities.description: A wasteland around the campus crawling with mage-eating monsters.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane, whose motifs shape the tower.

events.summary: To stabilize the Echoverse the Theorist creates Hexhaven as his inner sanctum.
events.quote: Hexhaven was created as his inner sanctum

events.summary: Harmonious mana merges and creates five elder sphinxes at the largest leyline confluence.
events.quote: harmonious mana merged, creating five elder sphinxes at the largest confluence of its leylines

events.summary: The elder sphinxes protect the people from the disasters caused by the Theorist's reality magic and found an institution to train them.
events.quote: the sphinxes formally founded an institution

events.summary: Uldaros Theorix builds the original fortress with reality-bending magic.
events.quote: The elder sphinx Uldaros Theorix used his reality-bending magic to build the original fortress

events.summary: The Theorist's magic leaves a wasteland around the campus for nearly a hundred miles.
events.quote: left a wasteland surrounding the campus for nearly a hundred miles

events.summary: The Founder Sphinxes select first-year cadets for induction after their trial.
events.quote: The Founder Sphinxes select the cadets they wish to enroll

relations.quote: Hexhaven was created as his inner sanctum
